name: waiver-realism-v5
responds_to: C02B-codex BLOCK at review commit 9352aef: canonical ESPN OP was treated as a literal player position instead of an offensive-player/superflex slot
supersedes: waiver-realism-v4 by append-only amendment (v1-v4 remain byte-for-byte preserved; only shared slot-alias eligibility and flexible-slot ordering are clarified here)

shared_slot_eligibility.alias_rule: OP and SFLX are exact aliases of SUPERFLEX everywhere the shared engine resolves or fills lineup slots; this is not a waiver-only special case
shared_slot_eligibility.rejections: K and DST are never eligible for FLEX, SUPERFLEX, OP, or SFLX
shared_slot_eligibility.ordering: all dedicated slots are filled before flexible slots; FLEX, SUPERFLEX, OP, and SFLX therefore absorb only bodies remaining after dedicated-position allocation
shared_slot_eligibility.unknown_slot_fallback: unchanged: an unknown non-alias slot accepts only a player whose nominal position exactly equals that slot

acceptance_tests: the unchanged supplemental OP waiver regression returns the legal cross-role swap
QB, RB, WR, and TE are accepted identically by SUPERFLEX, OP, and SFLX
K and DST are rejected identically by SUPERFLEX, OP, and SFLX
dedicated positions fill before every flexible alias
all v1-v4 acceptance tests and calibration dispositions remain unchanged
unchanged: all v1-v4 decision gates, opportunity-cost rules, shared weekly budget formula, season cap, counters, seeds, cost/accounting reconciliation, calibration records, and failure interpretation
failure_interpretation: deterministic alias, eligibility, ordering, or prior-suite failure blocks C02C; ambiguity preserves accepted C02B behavior; no coefficient or calibration result may change
